mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 200k signals stronger household income and consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly above zero in periods where PAYEMS growth exceeds 200k for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in the housing starts index exceeding 10% signals weakening residential investment and lower GDP growth, which reduces corporate earnings and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero when HOUST declines by more than 10% over six months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month contraction in the industrial production index below -2% signals a sharp deceleration in manufacturing activity, reducing corporate earnings and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero when INDPRO declines by more than 2% over three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures exceeding 3% signals weakening demand, which reduces corporate earnings and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero when GDPC1 declines by more than 3% over six months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a tightening labor market that increases wage pressure and reduces profit margins, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero when UNRATE falls below 5% for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures exceeding 2% combined with a 3-month decline in housing starts exceeding 10% signals a synchronized weakening in demand components, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls > 2% and HOUST falls > 10% over 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero when both GDPC1 declines by more than 2% and HOUST declines by more than 10% over three months (t-test p > 0.05).
